Frey syndrome (gustatory sweating) follows parotidectomy — auriculotemporal parasympathetic fibres misdirect to skin sweat
glands; confirm with Minor's starch-iodine test.
Ear-lobe numbness after parotidectomy is greater auricular nerve injury — warn patients before surgery.
~80% of salivary stones sit in the submandibular (Wharton's) duct — the classic story is mealtime pain and swelling.

Sources: standard head & neck surgical anatomy texts · ENT UK · Management of Salivary Gland Tumours — UK National Multidisciplinary Guidelines (2016).
VII = facial nerve; branches 'Ten Zebras Bit My Cheek' (temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular, cervical). Salivary gland tumours are on sheet 1 of 2.
